<b style="color: #333333;"><span style="font-size: 2em;">22nd Stratagem</span></b></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333;"><b><span style="font-size: x-large;"><br /></span></b></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<b style="color: #333333;"><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: x-large;"><span lang="zh-CN">关门捉贼</span></span></b></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">(guān
mén z</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">huō<span style="text-decoration: none;">
zéi)</span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>Shut the Door to Catch the Thief</i></span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
An opportunity to completely capture the enemy, when presented,
should be seized; allowing the enemy to escape sows the seeds for
future conflict.</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
During the Battle of Changping in 260 B.C., Bai Qi (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">白起</span></span>,
332-257 B.C.) succeeded Wang He (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">王龁</span></span>)
as the commanding general of the Qin army, and soon fought against
the Zhao army commanded by the inexperienced Zhao Kuo (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">赵括</span></span>,
died 260 B.C.). When Bai Qi was fighting Zhao Kuo, he allowed for
Zhao to win a battle, and then challenged him to a 'decisive' match
at a strategic position closer to the State of Qi. Bai Qi again let
the Zhao army win while quietly cutting off their supply lines.
Starving, Zhao's forces began killing one another for food, and in a
desperate attempt to break the blockage, Zhao Kuo was killed and his
army surrendered. Bai Qi had them buried alive [18].</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, serif; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Shut
the Door to Catch the Thief</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
is associated with the 23rd hexagram, <i>Mountain
over Earth</i>. A
Mountain resting over a weak foundation is vulnerable to collapse.
Here it is suggested to wait rather than to take direct action, and
let the opponent collapse onto itself [1],
[28].</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span>
	

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;">

LIST 22:</span></span></span></b></p>

<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: 2em;"><b>Sample Sentences 22:</b></span></p>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section74" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她意外地走进了男洗手间。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: She accidentally went
	into the boy’s bathroom.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	2) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你怎么跟他们建立了联系？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">我跟他们有点关系，所以他们愿意。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我应该买哪一个面膜？质量都很好。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	4) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她为什么跟她的男朋友分手了？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">我不知道，但是她偶然地抱怨过，他</span></span>
    </span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;一直找不到工作。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你不应该在这里买钻石，质量不太好。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: Since you bought the
	diamond here, the quality is not that good.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	6) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她是他的前女友。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我的女朋友经常提醒我少吃肥肉。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	8) </span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">让我们去公园捉虫子吧。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	9) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她很喜欢豆芽。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	10)  Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她为什么跟他分手了？他很幽默呀。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp; <span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">A:
	</span></span></span><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">跟他一起的时候，她没有兴奋的感</span></span>
    </span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;觉。</span></span></span></p>
</div>
